method.mc_standard_error: SD of paired repeat estimates / sqrt(repeats)
method.aggregation: equal component means within region; panel weights only for all_panels
method.pipeline_seeds: paired before averaging; shared evaluation random streams retained
method.group_bootstrap: repeat-averaged component scores; conditional on fitted pipeline seeds
method.sample_pooling: logmeanexp of joint probabilities and of each site marginal across consecutive equal-size repeats; no additional draws
limitations: SE is estimated from only 4 Monte Carlo repeats.
Repeat variability does not measure finite-sample log-probability bias.
Pooled estimates share samples across sample counts; they do not establish asymptotic convergence.
Numerical forward/probability precision is not tested by repeated sampling.
No test-based model selection or new probability scoring is performed.
